lines.2: A constitutional monarchy occupying the eastern part of the Scandinavian Peninsula in Northern Europe.
lines.3: Long story short, the scenery was insanely beautiful.
lines.6: 「So cold roses won't even bloom when I strike a pose!」
lines.7: 「Ooooh, yeah, it's freezing here. I figured it'd be cold since it's way up at the top of the map, but...」
lines.14: 「Come on, Yoppi. You've seen more than enough aurora already. We're going back.」
lines.16: 「That's what she says. You guys can head back first.」
lines.17: 「I can't believe Yoppi, of all people, who's so bad with the cold, has lasted this long...」
lines.18: 「Because I'm with Leo, so I'm warm.」
lines.21: 「Leo's really gotten reliable... I'm happy for you, but it's kind of lonely too...」
lines.22: 「Wanna try going out with me, Princess?」
lines.24: 「That's the first time I've ever been shot down in under a second.」
lines.27: 「Yoppi was always my number one, too...」
lines.28: The rest of our group headed back ahead of us.
lines.29: 「The aurora's so pretty... I feel like I could watch it forever.」
lines.32: Little by little, taking her time, Yoshimi was learning to trust me.
lines.33: So I had to live up to that trust too.
lines.34: 「Ahaha. You know, looking at something like this...」
lines.35: 「All the time I spent staring at the ground and worrying... feels kind of stupid now.」
lines.37: Even when something hurts, if you see something beautiful like this, or just let time pass, I'm sure you can recover.
lines.38: Even if there are more painful times ahead.
lines.39: 「All right, it's about time. Let's head back.」
